summary: Em dashes are absent from all three source trees (apps/web/src, packages/shared/src, apps/api/src): every en dash there is a numeric range (Z1–Z2, Z3–Z4, 60–90s, 2–3 weeks, 4:55–5:05) except five standalone '–' missing-value placeholders (SessionCard:36,39; SessionDetail:91,97; LogSheet:157), flagged low. The only real em-dash violations are in apps/api/seed/seed-research.sql (39 dashes across 39 lines): this seed is applied to production by the DB Migrate workflow and its explanation summaries/claims and research titles are shown to users in the session 'Why this session' panel and in the coach context, so each is high severity. Two of them (lines 248 and 2331) sit inside a verbatim paper title; the rest are generated prose/headings and take a colon, comma or parentheses. Also low: an em dash in the .dev.vars.example comment (line 1). AI-tell words (thrilled, revolutionary, seamless, unlock, empower, etc.) do not appear in any user-visible source; the gap is that the three runtime prompts (narration.ts:40, cron.ts:57, ai.ts:108) ban em dashes and markdown but not hype/hedging/AI tells, which AGENTS.md requires, so they are medium. Generic prose in the web copy is limited and already catalogued in research/audits/copy-voice.json (three noted here for completeness). Internal research/*.md notes contain many em dashes but are not user-visible and are out of scope. 49 findings total (39 high, 3 medium, 7 low).
